import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, list them here
    ]

    # List to hold transformed DataFrames from each source
    transformed_dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load source data
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Transformation:
        # Target schema: ['user_id': int, 'sad': float, 'stressed': float]
        # Source columns to map:
        #   'user_id' -> 'user_id'
        #   'sad.depressed' -> 'sad' (convert to float)
        #   'open.stressed' -> 'stressed' (convert to float)

        # Aggregate by user_id: average the sad.depressed and open.stressed values per user_id
        agg_df = df.groupby('user_id').agg({
            'sad.depressed': 'mean',
            'open.stressed': 'mean'
        }).reset_index()

        # Rename columns to target schema
        agg_df.rename(columns={
            'sad.depressed': 'sad',
            'open.stressed': 'stressed'
        }, inplace=True)

        # Ensure correct dtypes
        agg_df['user_id'] = agg_df['user_id'].astype(int)
        agg_df['sad'] = agg_df['sad'].astype(float)
        agg_df['stressed'] = agg_df['stressed'].astype(float)

        transformed_dfs.append(agg_df)

    # Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
    if len(transformed_dfs) > 1:
        result_df = pd.concat(transformed_dfs, ignore_index=True)
        # If user_id overlaps across sources, aggregate again by user_id
        result_df = result_df.groupby('user_id').agg({
            'sad': 'mean',
            'stressed': 'mean'
        }).reset_index()
    else:
        result_df = transformed_dfs[0]

    # Save the final transformed dataframe to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    result_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
